services.name: Range Rentals
services.desc: The ranges are rented throughout the year to various enforcement agencies in order to offset the high cost of operating the club. We do not rent the ranges on the weekend. Contact Kim Brunt to check availability if you wish to inquire about booking one of the ranges. Commencing in 2024 the rate for renting the ranges is $750 per day per range and only full days are rented. Pistol ranges can be rented 5 days a week. The rifle range is only available for renting on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays.
